accepted.question_text: Let W be the set of all functions ψ ∈ L²(R) such that {2^{j/2} ψ(2^j x − k) : j, k ∈ Z} is an orthonormal basis of L²(R). Is W, viewed as a subset of the unit sphere of L²(R), path connected in the L²(R) norm?

evidence.quote: Problem 2.1. Is the collection of all orthonormal wavelets (as a subset of the unit sphere in L2(R)) path connected in L2(R) norm?

accepted.question_text: For an orthonormal dyadic wavelet ψ ∈ L²(R), define its wavelet dimension function by D_ψ(ξ) = Σ_{j=1}^∞ Σ_{k∈Z} |ψ̂(2^j(ξ + k))|². If D is any function that arises as D_ψ for some orthonormal dyadic wavelet, is the set {ψ ∈ L²(R) : ψ is an orthonormal wavelet and D_ψ = D} path connected in L²(R)?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 2.1. Let D be any wavelet dimension function, i.e., D satisfies (D1)–(D4). Then, the collection of o.n. wavelets with the same dimension function {ψ ∈ L2(R) : ψ is an o.n. wavelet and Dψ = D}. is a path connected subset of L2(R).

accepted.question_text: Does there exist a function ψ in the Schwartz class that belongs to the Hardy space H²(R) = {f ∈ L²(R) : f̂(ξ) = 0 for ξ ≤ 0} and whose dyadic wavelet system {2^{j/2} ψ(2^j x − k) : j, k ∈ Z} is a Riesz basis for H²(R)?

evidence.quote: Problem 2.2. Does there exist a Riesz wavelet ψ in H2(R) such that ψ belongs to the Schwartz class?

accepted.question_text: If ψ ∈ L²(R) is an orthonormal dyadic wavelet, must there exist a wavelet set W ⊂ R such that W ⊂ supp ψ̂? In other words, must the Fourier support of every orthonormal wavelet contain a measurable set whose integer translates and dyadic dilates tile R modulo null sets?

evidence.quote: Problem 2.3. Is it true that for any orthonormal wavelet ψ ∈ L2(R), there exists a wavelet set W such that such that W ⊂ supp ˆψ ?

accepted.question_text: Is the collection of all dyadic Riesz wavelets dense in L²(R)? Equivalently, can every function in L²(R) be approximated arbitrarily well in L² norm by functions whose dyadic translates and dyadic dilates form a Riesz basis?

evidence.quote: Problem 2.4. Is the collection of all Riesz wavelets dense in L2(R)?

accepted.question_text: Let ψ be a Parseval wavelet on L²(R), and let V(ψ) be the closed linear span of its negative dilates {ψ_{j,k} : j < 0, k ∈ Z}. Is the intersection ⋂_{j∈Z} D^j(V(ψ)) equal to {0}, where D denotes dyadic dilation?

evidence.quote: Problem 2.5. Let ψ be a Parseval wavelet with the space of negative dilates V = V (ψ ). Is it true that ⋂ j∈ Z Dj(V (ψ )) = {0}?

accepted.question_text: Suppose ψ is a dyadic Bessel wavelet on L²(R) with Bessel bound strictly less than 1. Does there exist another function ψ′ such that the combined system generated by ψ and ψ′ is a Parseval frame for L²(R)?
accepted.context_brief: extending Bessel wavelets to Parseval frames

evidence.quote: Problem 2.6. Suppose ψ is Bessel wavelet with bound < 1. Does there exist ψ ′ such that the combined wavelet system {ψj,k :j,k ∈ Z} ∪ {ψ ′ j,k :j,k ∈ Z}. generated by ψ and ψ ′ is a Parseval frame?

accepted.question_text: For 0 < b < 1, define ψ_b ∈ L²(R) by ψ̂_b = 1_{(-1,-b)∪(b,1)}. For which values of b in the interval 1/8 < b ≤ 1/6 does the dyadic wavelet system generated by ψ_b form a frame wavelet?

evidence.quote: Problem 2.7. For 0 < b <1 define ψb ∈ L2(R) by ˆψb = 1(− 1, −b)∪ (b, 1). For what values of 1/ 8<b ≤ 1/ 6, is ψb a frame wavelet?

accepted.question_text: For which pairs (A, Γ), where A ∈ GL_n(R) is a dilation matrix and Γ ⊂ R^n is a full-rank lattice, does there exist an orthonormal wavelet associated with (A, Γ), meaning a function ψ ∈ L²(R^n) whose systems {|det A|^{j/2} ψ(A^j x − k) : j ∈ Z, k ∈ Γ} form an orthonormal basis of L²(R^n)?

evidence.quote: Problem 3.1. For what dilations A ∈ GLn(R) and lattices Γ ⊂ Rn, there exist an orthonormal wavelet associated with ( A, Γ)?

accepted.question_text: Characterize all pairs (A, Γ), where A ∈ GL_n(R) is a dilation matrix and Γ ⊂ R^n is a full-rank lattice, for which there exists a wavelet set W ⊂ R^n whose lattice translates by Γ partition R^n modulo null sets and whose dilates by powers of A also partition R^n modulo null sets.

evidence.quote: Problem 3.2. Characterize pairs of dilations A ∈ GLn(R) and lattices Γ ⊂ Rn for which wavelet set exists.

accepted.question_text: If ψ is an orthonormal wavelet or a Parseval wavelet associated with a pair (A, Γ), does Calderón’s formula Σ_{j∈Z} |ψ̂((A^T)^j ξ)|² = 1 hold for almost every ξ ∈ R^n?
accepted.context_brief: Calderón formula for general dilation-lattice pairs

evidence.quote: Problem 3.3. Does Calder´ on’s formula (3.7) ∑ j∈ Z |ˆψ ((AT )jξ)|2 = 1 for a.e. ξ ∈ Rn hold for any orthonormal (or Parseval) wavelet ψ associated with (A, Γ)?

accepted.question_text: Let Γ = Z^n. For which expansive dilation matrices A do there exist well-localized wavelets associated with A, possibly with multiple generators, where both the wavelet functions and their Fourier transforms have polynomial decay at infinity?

evidence.quote: Problem 3.4. Let Γ = Zn be the lattice of translates. For what expansive dilations A do there exist well-localized wavelets (possibly with multiple generators) ?

accepted.question_text: If A is an integer expansive matrix and Γ = Z^n, do there exist orthonormal wavelets associated with A whose generators all belong to the Schwartz class on R^n?

evidence.quote: Problem 3.5. Do Schwartz class wavelets exist for integer expansive dilations A and lattice Γ = Zn?

accepted.question_text: Suppose ψ is an orthonormal wavelet on R^n and ψ belongs to the Schwartz class. Must its Fourier transform ψ̂ be compactly supported?
accepted.context_brief: compact Fourier support of Schwartz wavelets

evidence.quote: Problem 3.6. Suppose ψ is an orthonormal wavelet such that ψ belongs to the Schwartz class. Is ˆψ necessarily compactly supported?
